description: Connect with community organizations for rent, utility, food, and emergency housing support. Call 211 or use the official directory to find your local service.
application_method: Call 211 or find your local 211 website. This app does not submit an application.
eligibility_notes: Local organizations set their own eligibility. Availability, hours, and funding vary by location.
intake_status: Contact the local organization; funding not confirmed
review_status: Official source reviewed; eligibility and intake must be confirmed

description: Find an LSC-funded civil legal aid organization serving your address. The official locator covers states and U.S. territories; individual providers determine the matters they can accept.
application_method: Use the official legal aid locator, then contact the identified provider.
eligibility_notes: Income limits, case priorities, service boundaries, and capacity are determined by each legal aid organization.
review_status: Official source reviewed; eligibility and intake must be confirmed

description: Find HUD-approved housing counseling agencies and ask about rental housing counseling or housing stability support available in your area.
application_method: Use the official HUD housing counseling directory. Confirm agency contact details on the external site.
eligibility_notes: Ask the agency whether it provides renter counseling in your area and whether there are fees. HUD approval is not a promise of financial assistance.
intake_status: Confirm directly with the counseling agency

description: Find state-specific legal information and referrals to nonprofit legal aid. Select your state on the external site for local guidance.
application_method: Select your state on LawHelp.org and follow the provider’s contact instructions.
eligibility_notes: Information is educational. Legal representation, eligibility, and intake vary by provider.
review_status: Official link; website returned 503 during review

description: Locate local shelter and emergency housing referrals. If you are unsafe or at immediate risk, contact emergency services or a local crisis service.
application_method: Call 211 and describe the kind of immediate housing help you need.
eligibility_notes: Shelter beds and placement cannot be guaranteed. Local services confirm current options.
review_status: Official source reviewed; eligibility and intake must be confirmed

description: Nonprofit civil legal aid serving Bucks, Chester, Delaware, and Montgomery Counties in Pennsylvania. Ask intake about housing concerns and current eligibility.
application_method: Call 877-429-5994 Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–1 p.m., or follow the online application instructions at lasp.org/apply. Confirm hours before contacting.
eligibility_notes: Income, case type, service area, and capacity requirements may apply. The app does not determine eligibility.
review_status: Official source reviewed; eligibility and intake must be confirmed

description: Civil legal assistance for eligible Philadelphia residents. Review the official housing practice and intake pages for current contact options.
application_method: Review the official website for the correct housing intake route.
eligibility_notes: Philadelphia service area; case priorities and eligibility apply. Contact the organization before relying on availability.
review_status: Official source reviewed; eligibility and intake must be confirmed

description: External local program information for Philadelphia. Review current requirements and participation instructions on the official program website.
application_method: Visit the official external program website. Creating a StableHome discussion does not enroll you.
eligibility_notes: Program rules are specific to Philadelphia and may change. A private discussion does not pause a court case or extend deadlines.
review_status: Portal reachable; program details need manual review

description: Find local energy assistance and utility support organizations through your local 211 service.
application_method: Contact your local 211 and ask about utility assistance.
eligibility_notes: Each program has its own rules and funding limits. No available funds are confirmed by this listing.
review_status: Official source reviewed; eligibility and intake must be confirmed

description: Ask for local benefits enrollment and counseling referrals. Confirm separately how each program treats support from friends or family.
application_method: Call 211 and request benefits counseling referrals in your area.
eligibility_notes: SSI, SNAP, and housing programs follow different rules. Recording support here does not protect eligibility.
review_status: Official source reviewed; eligibility and intake must be confirmed
